title: Autopay Discount Methods for Late-Billed Rental Property Service Contracts Installments
content:
**Discount rule.** The autopay discount on a late-billed Rental Property Service Contracts monthly installment follows how the contract pays:

1. When the most recent premium payment was made by ACH and no returned payment was billed back on the contract in the twelve months before the installment, the installment is reduced by 3 percent: it is multiplied by one less 0.03.
2. When the most recent premium payment was made by ACH but a returned payment was billed back in those months, a flat $1.00 is taken off the installment.
3. Otherwise no autopay discount applies.

The discount acts on the installment as it stands after every rate credit it carries, and the installment after the autopay discount is rounded to the cent once at the end.

**Records read.** The payment method of the latest premium payment in the contract's billing history; the returned payment charges and their dates.

## Hypothetical installment of $45.5905 before the discount

| Last premium payment | Returned payment in the 12 months | Installment |
|---|---|---|
| ACH | none | $45.5905 times 0.97 is $44.222785: **$44.22** |
| ACH | one | $45.5905 less $1.00: **$44.59** |
| check | none | **$45.59** |
